The human icon no longer displays an alien
Esc keybind now opens the pause menu
Limited to 60 FPS
Return of the video intro when launching a new game
Fixed issues with symbiotic extension on some ships

notes.title: Big update including The Alliance content on its way
notes.notes:
We've been working for weeks now on the next update. We've migrated the source code to a newer version of Unity so most of the system-level bugs (such as unresponsive mouse) will mostly get fixed one and for all.
We're also porting the Alliance content (currently only available on Switch) wich includes new ships, new aliens, alien escort missions, updated graphics and a new ending!
Progress on the tasks is smooth. But as the update will be deployed on all platforms (Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android), it requires a lot a QA.
The good news is that we're confident the update will be ready in January!

notes.title: Sigma Theory: Global Cold War To Release On April 18th
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/193fd8c3969c88a44cebcd9be287db2070575ce4.png

From the creators of the award-winning sci-fi game Out There comes Sigma Theory: Global Cold War, Mi-Clos Studio’s new futuristic turn-based cold war spy simulation game. After a paradigm-shifting scientific discovery, the titular Sigma Theory, the player is invited to build their own intelligence agency and delve deep into a shadowy world of subterfuge and back-stabbing diplomacy. Heavily influenced by the creators’ real-life experience in the intelligence industry, players will recruit, bribe, and assassinate to ensure their chosen nation will lead the planet towards a radical new future. Sigma Theory is set to release on April 18th, 2019 for PC, Mac and Linux. 

Wishlist now on Steam!

notes.title: First Multiverse update now live!
notes.notes:
Hi, Space Travelers
We are pleased to announce that the first Multiverse update dubbed Cemetery Gates is now live on Steam!
As promised, new game modes and content has been delivered!
We are very curious to hear your feedback in the forum.
Full details below.

Multiverse I - Cemetery Gates
EASY MODE
First, the long-awaited 'easy mode'. We've been strongly against that in the past as it would change the whole spirit of the game. 
But we think that it's a shame some people are not able to experience our game or get quite frustrated because of its evil difficulty. So this issue has been addressed.
Also, a specific leaderboard has been created for this mode.

GAS GIANT RINGS
They were missing for far too long, so we thought that adding rings around the gas giants would be a great cosmetic addition. Well, maybe it's not only cosmetic. 

CEMETERY GATES GAME MODE
The most important addition is a new game mode called 'Cemetery Gates'. 
In this mode, you will encounter the last 10 space ships you have lost during previous runs, right where you've left them. You'll be able to scavenge the resources that you've left inside or simply take over the ship and continue your adventure. 
This mode will open up new strategies and possibilities. 
It will also boost the early game, that is is sometimes slow, as you'll find more ships around the starting point (remember all those runs prematurely ended because of bad luck?).

Enjoy!

Michael P.

notes.title: Announcing Multiverse Update Series
notes.notes:
http://outtheregame.com/medias/cemeteryGatesI.jpg

Out There expands its universe with Multiverse Update Series
When developing Out There: Ω Edition, we rebuilt it entirely in a new engine so we could port it to PC.
Indeed, the initial development, started in 2012, was achieved during a very difficult part of our life where we didn't have any money or expectations for the game.
Now that we have solid and versatile fundations, 3 years of players feedback and our own ideas, we have decided to expands the original experience that Out There is offering.

We have planned to release a series of updates that we call Multiverse.
Each Multiverse will add basic stuff you'd expect from an update. Like bug fix and small improvements.
But more importantly, it will bring new game modes and contents.

About that, the first update is on its way and will arrive on PC and mobiles pretty soon. Read on.


Multiverse I - Cemetery Gates
The first Multiverse update will get 3 new major additions.

EASY MODE
First, the long-awaited 'easy mode'. We've been strongly against that in the past as it would change the whole spirit of the game.
But we think that it's a shame some people are not able to experience our game or get quite frustrated because of its evil difficulty. So this issue has been addressed.

GAS GIANT RINGS
They were missing for far too long, so we thought that adding rings around the gas giants would be a great cosmetic addition. Well, maybe it's not only cosmetic.

CEMETERY GATES GAME MODE
The most important addition is a new game mode called 'Cemetery Gates'.
In this mode, you will encounter the last 10 space ships you have lost during previous runs, right where you've left them. You'll be able to scavenge the resources that you've left inside or simply take over the ship and continue your adventure.
This mode will open up new strategies and possibilities.
It will also boost the early game, that is is sometimes slow, as you'll find more ships around the starting point (remember all those runs prematurely ended because of bad luck?).

Multiverse I - Cemetery Gates is a free update that will release early October on PC, iOS and Android.

Cheers,

Michael.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6 live!
notes.notes:
Many bug fixes in this patch. Thanks to all of you for reporting them and for your patience!

FEATURED CHANGES:
It now possible to scroll the map when the telescope is broken or missing, within the space folder's reach.
If both the space folder and the telescope are broken or missing, it is impossible to scroll the map, though.

A bug was preventing to travel to the red objective. It has been fixed.

Various bugs that were appearing during the travel animation have been fixed.

FULL CHANGELOG:
CHANGED: Unloading screen appears when quitting the game
FIXED: Russian font was not loading correctly
FIXED: bugs when forgetting a technology
CHANGED: It is now possible to scroll the map without a telescope
FIXED: Background management for wide screens
OPTIMIZED: Particles during travel animation
FIXED: Houston achievement was not unlocked correctly
FIXED: Wormhole jumps were not counted in the final score
FIXED: Shortcuts bugs
FIXED: Star destructions were not counted in the final score
FIXED: Terraformed planets were not counted in the final score
FIXED: Cold Heart achievement can now be unlocked
FIXED: UI issues
FIXED: Bugs preventing to travel to the red objective
FIXED: An adventure was not translated in spanish
FIXED: An adventure was not translated in german
